label: TP
reason: User input flows through request.getParameter(), enters HashMap storage, returns to bar variable, then combines with TESTFILES_DIR to form fileName. Paths.get(fileName) at line 59 allows directory traversal attacks (../ patterns) since no validation/sanitization occurs on the constructed path. The XSS finding is mitigated by encodeForHTML() calls.

evidence.note: User input flows from parameter -> HashMap -> fileName -> Paths.get vulnerable to path traversal
Paths.get(fileName) constructs path from unsanitized user input enabling directory traversal
